package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMigration021AddsBoundedDurableHandoffAndFailsClosedDown(t *testing.T) {
	_, current, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	require.True(t, ok)
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(current), "../../../../"))
	up, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/021_teacher_onboarding_planner_handoff.up.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/021_teacher_onboarding_planner_handoff.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for _, required := range []string{
		"BEGIN;", "COMMIT;",
		"CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff", "status IN ('queued', 'dispatching', 'accepted', 'message_pending', 'delivered', 'active_path', 'blocked')",
		"command_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE", "command_teacher_job_id UUID NOT NULL", "request_hash CHAR(64)",
		"state_ref_kind", "state_ref_version", "goal_code", "goal_version", "graph_version",
		"planner_handoff_id UUID UNIQUE", "readiness_observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ", "notification_command_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE",
		"notification_message_id UUID UNIQUE", "source_teacher_job_id UUID UNIQUE", "state = 'handoff_pending'",
		"ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (student_id, state_ref_kind, state_ref_version)",
		"protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity", "teacher onboarding handoff identity is immutable",
		"Planner acknowledgement is immutable", "Dialog delivery acknowledgement is immutable", "status transition is invalid",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete", "trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(up), required)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{
		"BEGIN;", "LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;",
		"LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;", "COMMIT;",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(down), required)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"profile_json", "response_body", "prompt_body", "model_body", "course_id", "learning_path_id", "lesson_id"} {
		require.NotContains(t, strings.ToLower(string(up)), strings.ToLower(forbidden))
	}
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "immutable onboarding handoff evidence is retained permanently")
	for _, required := range []string{
		"DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate",
		"DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete",
		"DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity",
		"DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate()",
		"DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete()",
		"DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity()",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(down), required)
	}
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "state = 'handoff_pending'")
	require.Less(t, strings.Index(string(down), "RAISE EXCEPTION"), strings.Index(string(down), "DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff"))
}
